title: King of Wrath
author: Ana Huang
summary: Part of the Kings of Sin series of billionaire romances, this book follows Dante Russo and Vivian Lau, who are pulled together despite their very different positions.
readIf: you like glossy, high-heat romance with powerful characters.
skipIf: you want a low-spice story or a book with a strong plot outside the central couple.

pairings.reason: The first book in the author’s Twisted series, with a similar mix of wealth, power and desire.
A lighter, geeky romance with similar sparks, but a much more tender and humorous heroine.
A fake-relationship romance with a brooding hero and a lot of slow-building tension.
